name: Faerie

attributes.attribute: only slightly tied to Celtic world
draws from folkloric images of diminished fairy gods
source of the images of small gods

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Faerie is a contemporary religious movement. It belongs to American neopaganism. Many place it within the Celtic Revival. Its bond to the old Celtic ways is slight. The name comes instead from folklore images of the fairy realm. Those images show gods reduced in power and scale.

okr.objective: Faerie is a current neopagan tradition of America.
key_results: Faerie belongs to modern American neopaganism.
It is often classed under the Celtic Revival.
Its name comes from folklore images of small gods.
It is only slightly tied to historic Celtic belief.
